en: 4. The Question on the Leopardess “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say that ‘one quality of the leopardess should be adopted,’ which is that one quality that should be adopted?
“Just as, Great King, the leopardess conceives only once and does not approach the male again and again.”
In the same way, great king, a yogin, a practitioner of yoga, having seen that there will be future rebirth,
arising, lying in a womb, death, dissolution, destruction, ruin, the fear of *saṃsāra*, an evil destination,
and the oppression of adversity, should apply wise attention, thinking: "I shall not link up again with renewed existence."
“Great King, this is one quality that should be adopted from the female leopard.
This was also spoken, Great King, by the Blessed One, the God above Gods, in the *Sutta Nipāta*, in the *Dhaniya-gopālaka Sutta*:
‘Like a bull, having severed its bonds…’”
Like a naga tearing down a rotten creeper,
I shall not enter the bed of a womb again,
even if you, O god, wish for rain.”
The Fourth Question: On the Dīpiniyaṅga.
